failure_class.stage: S4 source_reconciliation, on the reuse path

evidence.cause: components/readme/reconciliation/dispositions.py: normalize() folds a placement into a deterministic section by rewriting entry["fact_ids"] = sorted(cited | set(rendering_fact_ids(destination, facts))). For identity and navigation that set contains identity:revision. citable_fact_ids() is built from _packet_fact_records() -> bounded_records(), which skips _EXCLUDED_FROM_PACKETS - and identity:revision is in it by design (core/facts.py line 179, whose comment says the exclusion exists so the bundled call cache reuses across a revision bump). What is stored is the normalised output; core/llm/jobs.py re-judges a stored output against the current schema before reuse; the enum refuses identity:revision; _parse returns None and the store records cache_stale / OutputRejected. Every round, every process.
evidence.request_digest_is_stable: c4132101affc in every round of both runs - the packet and schema never moved, only the re-judge rejects.
evidence.batch_2_control: a3ce39d30513 reuses cleanly every time; it places nothing into a deterministic section.
evidence.offline_reproduction: Re-judging the stored batch-1 reply reproduces exactly 3 rejections, all of one shape: $.dispositions[N].fact_ids[4]: 'identity:revision' is not one of [...]. Of the 41 IDs normalize() can add for this repository's deterministic sections, exactly one - identity:revision - is outside the enum.
evidence.fix_proven: Widen citable_fact_ids() to admit what code writes as well as what the packet shows: the union of rendering_fact_ids() over the deterministic sections, the UNRESOLVED/CONTRADICTED code-unit IDs, the SUPPORTED install_command and build_test_asset IDs, and BANNER_FACT_ID/HOMEPAGE_FACT_ID/ENTERPRISE_FACT_ID. Replaying _parse on the stored reply with the enum widened from 139 to 140 values: accepted, zero rejections. No provider call; nothing written.
evidence.widening_is_safe: Every added ID is one deterministic code would have written into the entry anyway, so the model can invent nothing new; binding_errors still rejects an ID naming no fact.
rejected_alternatives: Re-judge a stored output against the schema it was stored under - defeats the re-judge-before-reuse design, whose point is that a corrected check takes effect without a call.
Stop normalize() adding identity:revision - drops the citation that proves the supersession.
Revert 352fd35 - reopens the decode runaway this same run just proved closed.
evidence.regression: Introduced by 352fd35 today. Under item 40's pattern ^(...|identity|...): the string identity:revision matched, and before item 40 fact_ids was {"type": "string"}; both earlier shapes re-validated the normalised output and the cache reused.

portfolio_impact: Not a Go finding. identity:revision is a fact every repository has, _EXCLUDED_FROM_PACKETS is universal, and normalize()'s deterministic fold is universal: any repository whose reconciler places one inherited unit into identity or navigation cannot pass BC-11 today. The same shape reaches wherever rendering_fact_ids() (every SUPPORTED fact of the section's kinds, unbounded) exceeds bounded_records()'s LINK_CAP, EXAMPLE_CAP or SYMBOL_CAP.
bc11_consequence: The rerun must make the S4 call; this gateway does not return the same answer twice; the dispositions moved (VERIFIED_MOVE 9 -> 2, OMIT_UNSUPPORTED 7 -> 14, VERIFIED_PRESERVE 18 -> 22, SUPERSEDE_REDUNDANT 25 -> 23) and README.md went from 236 visible lines to 223. The bundle re-sealed and its own proof was withdrawn.
